name: MachinePanel
description: An invented on-premise inference appliance, where the page is the machine's front panel
intent: A page that draws and runs the thing it is selling. Every screw, blade, gauge and LED is CSS or inline SVG, and one integrated load value drives the fan period, the lit gauge ticks, the coil glow and all four readouts, so throwing the power switch changes the whole instrument rather than one widget.

source.title: Machine Front Panel Page
source.author: Ray Velez
source.changed: New brand, copy and model numbers, and a palette moved from amber and cyan to sodium and ice
